facts: The path .ai-intelligence/ai-development/findings/ declared in the local-project-evidence discovery source does not exist in the repository; only .ai-intelligence/ai-development/runs/ was scannable.

authority_base.reachable is true only in MNT-20260815T141330Z (branch main, remote_sha == local_head 7872172); it is false with remote_sha null in both MNT-20260817T200951Z and MNT-20260831T190559Z, which ran on ephemeral session branches claude/zen-carson-bt3bjc and claude/zen-carson-v4auwl. The four earliest 2026-08-15 runs carry no authority_base field at all.
MNT-20260815T111324Z-maintain.json records the blocker 'PR pending: gh unavailable; merge intentionally left to human review' and status 'partial' with blocked_items 1.

Git commit 33c0f65 (2026-08-16, 'chore: release shared assets without mandatory PRs') flipped automation-policy release.allow_direct_push from false to true, removed the mandatory pull-request release strategy from AGENTS.md/README.md, and added scripts/check_authority.py plus tests asserting independent review, no force push and no protection bypass remain required.
The MNT-20260831T190559Z run record, run dir and catalog snapshot are present but untracked in git as of this scan; run status is 'planned' with empty results.

In MNT-20260815T141330Z-maintain.json, results.candidates is 0 while results.metrics.candidates is 3, and results.deferred is an object {research, inventory} while results.metrics.deferred is a list of four work-item IDs.

schema_version stays '1.0' across run records whose results object grew from 8 keys (2026-08-15 09:26) to 16 keys (11:13) to 20 keys (14:13); plan_schema_version 1.1 and authority_base appear only from 14:13 onward.
Every plan in the window sets token_budget_per_run: null and time_budget_minutes: null, and no run record contains measured token or wall-clock actuals.

MNT-20260817T200951Z deferred RMD-G14-001 and RMD-SKILLEFF-001 with reason 'run action cap (max_action_items_per_run=3) reached'; MNT-20260815T141330Z notes action caps were 'overridden to 100 by explicit user request'.

MNT-20260815T120030Z-maintain.json lists controller fixes discovered: model_conditions text scope, guidance propagation without release, promotion gate for deterministic changes, adjacent-cell trial inflation, no candidate-revision path before evaluation, and version collision across pending releases (0.1.1 vs 0.1.2).

MNT-20260815T141330Z remediation_status shows techlog consumer outcomes of unresolved for RMD-F03-001 and RMD-G22-001, and decision-required for RMD-I14-001, RMD-K06-001 and RMD-K13-001; DEC-20260815T120045Z-7415E4AB (I05/I14) is still listed as an open decision package in the 2026-08-31 plan, 16 days after creation.

All six previously registered discovery candidates (CND-20260815-001..006) were classified duplicate against I16, I02, K03, J07, A01 and K02; the bootstrap run notes state the local-project-evidence source produced no candidates in its only prior scan (2026-08-15T09:29:50Z).

The four deferred controller self-update work items WRK-20260815T124426Z-194E74F4/A307F153/DF7F2470/E4C69876 are already mapped to catalog problems K11, H02, K01 and E05 respectively, and are all in state 'completed'.
inferences: The unreachable authority base is a recurring condition (2 of the 3 runs that record it, spanning 2026-08-17 to 2026-08-31), not a one-off: it means the declared workflow step 'reconcile with the remote authority base, then commit/push authority state with remote verification' cannot execute, so each run plans from an unverified local head and the ledger's released/pushed states are not externally confirmable.

The gh-unavailable blocker on 2026-08-15 plausibly motivated the 2026-08-16 policy change to reviewed direct release; the adaptation to a missing sandbox capability was to relax the delivery gate rather than to gate on capability availability. The change was guarded (check_authority.py + tests), so this is a controlled relaxation rather than an I17-style bypass.

The results/metrics counter divergence and the frozen schema_version are the same duplication-diverges-on-update mechanism as catalog A03 (with A14 for the unbumped version), applied to a machine-readable state record instead of a design document; the practical response (single source of truth, derive one view from the other) is identical, so it is a duplicate rather than a new problem.

Absence of token/time budgets and actuals means the 'unexplained time or token loss' theme cannot be evidenced from local run data at all — this is itself covered by G22/K06/K11 and does not warrant a new entry.
The fixed per-run action cap with recurring identical deferral reasons, and the 16-day-old open decision package, are throughput/oversight-bandwidth symptoms already carried by J15, J03 and G14.

records.title: Agentの成果公開・検証leg（remote到達、PR作成）がsandboxで利用できず、未検証のlocal headのまま完了状態が記録される
records.summary: Agentの運用workflowは『remote authority baseと突き合わせ、remote検証付きでcommit/pushする』ことを前提にしているが、実行sandboxからoriginへ到達できない運転が続いており（2026-08-17と2026-08-31はreachable false／remote_sha null、2026-08-15のみtrue）、runは検証不能なlocal headを基準に計画・記録される。gh CLIが使えずPRを作れなかった事象も同時に記録されており、成果は『released／pushed』としてledgerに残る一方で、外部からその状態を確認する手段がない。観測された適応はcapability不足をgateするのではなく、mandatory PRを外してdirect releaseを許可する方向へ配送gateを緩めることだった。結果として、実行環境のcapability欠落が、成果の可視性とreview gateの強度を静かに切り下げる。
records.proposed_category: 運用・費用・測定・再現性
